answer_1.quote: We choose two representative tasks: search engine optimization (SEO) Writer (W) and Image Prompt Generator (G). For each task, we create multiple queries and design evaluation metrics to measure the quality of responses.
datasets: Image Prompt Generator prompts (6 prompts, 20 text-to-image prompts)
answer_1.outputs: Generated SEO web page content and optimized text-to-image prompts

answer_2.quote: For the SEO Writer task, we use an API called SEO Review Tools (SEO) to measure the quality of generated content... For the Image Generator task, we calculate the alignment between the prompt and the image using the CLIP model as the evaluation metric.
